jobs.title: Full Stack Developer – Agentic AI & Automation
jobs.description:
**Full Stack Developer – Agentic AI & Automation**
==================================================

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong experience in application development, AI integration, and workflow automation. This role focuses on building scalable software solutions while leveraging Agentic AI, AI-powered workflows, and intelligent automation to streamline business operations.

The ideal candidate combines frontend and backend development expertise with hands-on experience building AI agents, orchestrating automated processes, integrating multiple systems, and developing solutions that can independently execute tasks, make decisions, and interact with external tools.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications.
* Build and integrate AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Develop agentic workflows capable of executing multi-step tasks, using tools, retrieving information, and interacting with external systems.
* Design and implement automated workflows to reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Integrate LLMs and AI services into applications using APIs and orchestration frameworks.
* Develop AI agents with tool-calling capabilities, memory, contextual reasoning, and task execution.
* Connect third-party platforms, APIs, databases, and business applications to create end-to-end automation solutions.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and knowledge retrieval capabilities when required.
* Build backend services, APIs, and frontend interfaces to support AI-driven applications.
* Monitor, test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI agents and automated workflows for accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve existing systems and business processes.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Proven experience in Full Stack Software Development.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience with frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Angular.
* Backend development experience using Node.js, Python, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services.
* Knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
* Hands-on experience integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.
* Practical experience developing AI agents and agentic workflows.
* Understanding of tool calling, function calling, agent orchestration, and multi-step task execution.
* Experience building workflow automation solutions and connecting multiple systems.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, context management, and structured AI outputs.
* Experience with Git, version control, and software development best practices.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI tool integrations.
* Experience implementing RAG architectures and vector databases.
* Experience integrating webhooks, event-driven systems, and asynchronous processing.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and application deployment.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking abilities.
* Ability to design AI agents that can execute tasks reliably, not just generate text or responses.
* Comfortable working with AI technologies and automation frameworks.
* Ability to build scalable, maintainable, and secure applications.
* Independent, proactive, and focused on delivering practical solutions that improve efficiency.

### **Contractor Perks**

* Work with international clients while maintaining your independent contractor status.
* Minimum 5 paid days off annually, plus US holidays.
* Free access to career growth learning modules through Hyre Academy.
* Scheduled rate increases based on applicable contract terms and performance.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Enumerate is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to join our team! This is a highly hands-on role for engineers who thrive in product-driven environments, move quickly, and are comfortable working alongside APIs, and data-rich systems. This is a remote opportunity. We are seeking contractors located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

End-to-End Feature Development

* Design and implement user-facing features across frontend and backend systems

* Build and evolve APIs and services that integrate data pipelines and product workflows

* Translate product requirements and UX designs into high-quality, maintainable code

* Rapidly prototype and iterate based on user feedback and experimentation results

Frontend & UX Integration

* Implement intuitive user interfaces

* Handle edge cases, fallbacks, and user feedback

* Ensure UI performance, accessibility, and responsiveness.

Backend & Integration

* Develop backend services that orchestrate business logic, and data access.

* Integrate with internal APIs, data services, and third-party AI platforms.

* Implement secure, scalable request handling, including latency and cost considerations

* Support feature flags, configuration, and experimentation frameworks.

Quality, Reliability & Observability

* Write automated tests across frontend and backend components.

* Implement logging, monitoring, and basic performance tracking

* Participate in code reviews and adhere to team engineering standards

* Help diagnose and resolve production issues

  

**Required Qualifications**

* BS or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

* 4+ years of experience building full stack web applications.

* Proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or similar).

* Strong backend experience with at least one language such as Python, Node.js, Java, or Go.

* Experience building and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing.
* Exposure to data pipelines or analytics tooling.
* Comfort working in fast-moving, iterative product teams.
